I am a young man with some schooling, and I know that using improved seed and a bit of fertilizer helps my maize grow better, even though I cannot afford very much. My family has just over one hectare on this plot, so we will work it ourselves for most tasks, but during planting and harvest I will likely need to hire a few extra hands from the village to finish in time. The rains in Mbeya are usually good enough that I do not need to irrigate, but weeds and pests can be a problem, so I will use chemicals to control them.
